name: Arcane Insight
source: Inner Sea Gods pg. 207, Faiths of Balance pg. 24
body:
Source Inner Sea Gods pg. 207, Faiths of Balance pg. 24
Magical insight helps you evade attacks.

Prerequisites: Arcane ShieldAPG, arcane spellcaster, caster level 10th, worshiper of Nethys.

Benefit: Whenever you use Arcane Shield, you also gain a +1 insight bonus to AC for 1 round.
